title: Ning Li's disappearance after breakthrough research
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Ning Li's disappearance after breakthrough research, about 1990s-2000s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these cases like like uh like Ning Lee or whatever, like folks that are clearly doing like breakthrough research on the margins of some interesting subjects and then they get sort of poof, they disappear.

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher and commentator, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a scientist named Ning Li. He says she was one of several people doing breakthrough research on the edges of strange subjects in the United States in the 1990s and 2000s, and then simply vanished from view. He offers her as an example of how such work may disappear into secrecy.
